text:
sara.k: Heads up — ran Pelotonix LoRA merge + int4 quant smoke on riff-7b-lora and seeing token probability drops on invoice lines compared to fp16. small quickpack attached.
omar.r: ok can you paste the top-level diff? is this after the adapter merge or before quant?
sara.k: after merge then quant. pipeline: merge -> convert -> quantize -> run evalpack. command i used:
```bash
./tools/merge_lora.py --base riff-7b --lora pelotonix/lora.tar --out merged-riff7b-lora.pt
python -m convert.quant --model merged-riff7b-lora.pt --fmt ggml --quant 4
./bin/run_evalpack --pack quick-invoice --model merged-riff7b-lora-int4.ggml
```
dinesh.p: can you share a minimal failing example? numeric deltas are common, but invoice amounts flipping is suspicious.
sara.k: short snippet from evalpack (gold vs int4):
```
Q: "Total due: $"
FP16: "123.45"
INT4: "12.345"
log-prob diff token 3: -4.2 -> -11.8
```
omar.r: hmm that's consistent with a tokenization shift or decimal token boundary getting split. which tokenizer did you use to encode pre/post?
sara.k: used the repo tokenizer (v2.1.0) — linter shows same vocab hash. double-checked BPE merges.
dinesh.p: two quick checks: 1) run evalpack with --no-prefix-cache to rule out KV cache mix, 2) run a direct fp16 vs int4 generation on same seed w/o LoRA (just base) to isolate quantization vs lora.
sara.k: running now. queued jobs:
- base fp16 vs int4 (no lora)
- merged lora fp16 vs int4
- merged lora int4 with --no-prefix-cache
(links will be in the thread when done)
eval-bot: job 1766005450 queued: base-fp16-vs-int4 (ETA ~4m) :hourglass_flowing_sand: 
omar.r: also check tokenizer normalization: decimal vs thousands separators. i've seen datasets where "123.45" tokenizes differently if whitespace differs.
sara.k: good point. i noticed some training examples had a trailing "\n" before amounts. i'll normalize and re-run.
dinesh.p: if repro persists, run a quick ngram perplexity compare on the invoice prompt set and dump the top-k tokens for the diverging position. that usually reveals whether it's a token split or probability mass shift.
sara.k: uploaded results for base-run: https://s3.redwood/pelotonix/quickpack/base-fp16-vs-int4-1766005489.json
summary: base-int4 shows small token logprob shifts but no magnitude that would flip decimal placement. implies LoRA merge + quant pipeline likely cause.
omar.r: can you try re-merging with float16 intermediate (avoid casting to fp32 during merge) — sometimes merge script does unexpected dtype casts.
sara.k: re-merge with --keep-fp16 gave different outcome: merged fp16-int4 still shows drift but smaller. attaching diff: https://s3.redwood/pelotonix/quickpack/merged-fp16-diff-1766005674.txt
dinesh.p: ok we have an angle: quantization amplification of adapter deltas. action items:
- sara: run targeted evalpack with only amount-related prompts (already queued) and enable token-level debug (dump top-5 logits)
- omar: audit merge script for dtype casts and document any casts to fp32
- me: prepare a minimal repro that isolates LoRA delta magnitude vs quant scaling
sara.k: will post token-level dumps once done. thanks all :pray:
